versions.changelog:
App builder skill v2.0.0 introduces a new name and offers an updated, more structured approach for constructing modern full-stack applications.

- Renamed from "christy-app-builder" to "eric-app-builder" with updated branding throughout.
- Skill now covers project detection, 2025 tech stack selection, scaffolding patterns, implementation planning, feature building, and development coordination.
- Enhanced project detection with a clear keyword matrix for matching user requests to recommended tech stacks.
- Provides up-to-date technology defaults (Next.js 16, TypeScript 5.7+, Tailwind v4, Supabase, etc.) and alternatives for backend and deployment needs.
- Details a modular project structure with feature isolation, shared code, strict server/client separation, and route grouping.
- Defines robust planning workflows and feature development templates to guide from requirements to deployment, including error handling and recovery strategies.
